title: Mobile-safe chat panel scrolling and overflow fixes

requirements.summary: Make the chat message list scroll vertically within the chat card on mobile while keeping the composer visible and preventing overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile-sized viewports, adding enough messages causes the chat message area to scroll vertically instead of growing beyond the chat panel bounds.
The message composer area (input, send button, attachment UI) remains accessible and does not get pushed off-screen as messages accumulate.
No horizontal scrolling is introduced in the chat panel during normal use.

file_operations.description: Adjust the chat card layout to be a strict flex column with a constrained, vertically scrollable message region (e.g., ensure the scroll container has flex-1 + min-h-0 and hides horizontal overflow) while keeping the composer as a non-scrolling, always-visible bottom section. Use the existing shadcn/ui Card and ScrollArea components without modifying files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure long message text (including nested replies) wraps within the chat width and never causes horizontal overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Long message content wraps naturally within the chat panel width on mobile (no text rendering outside the card).
Very long unbroken strings (e.g., long URLs) do not force horizontal overflow; they break/wrap within the message container.
Reply content exhibits the same wrapping behavior as top-level messages.

file_operations.description: Update message and reply content containers to enforce wrapping and overflow-safe text behavior (e.g., word breaking/overflow wrapping, whitespace handling, and min-width constraints on flex children) so long/unbroken strings cannot create horizontal overflow at any nesting depth.

Ensure reply composer input row layout cannot create horizontal overflow on mobile (e.g., apply min-w-0 to flex children where needed and avoid any fixed-width assumptions) while keeping all user-facing text in English.

requirements.summary: Make attached images (posted and composer previews) responsive on mobile so they never exceed the chat panel width or contribute to overflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Posted images scale down to fit within the chat panel on mobile (no overflow beyond the card).
Image attachment previews in the composer also scale appropriately on mobile.
Image aspect ratio is preserved and images remain viewable (no unintended cropping that hides most of the image).

file_operations.description: Update posted image rendering to be responsive within the message column (e.g., max-width 100%, height auto, and overflow-safe container styles) so images always fit inside the chat panel while preserving aspect ratio.

Update composer attachment preview sizing to be responsive (e.g., constrain to available width with max-width 100% and preserve aspect ratio) so previews cannot overflow the chat composer area on mobile.

requirements.summary: Stabilize chat panel height behavior in embeddings (Chat page and Calendar month page) to avoid nested overflow and ensure message list scrolling works in both contexts on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile, the chat panel fits within its parent container on the Chat page and Calendar month page without content spilling outside the intended chat box.
The chat message list scroll works correctly in both embeddings (standalone chat page and calendar page).

file_operations.description: Replace/adjust the standalone chat container sizing to use a mobile-safe height calculation (prefer 100dvh-based sizing) and ensure the wrapper provides a proper flex/height constraint (including min-h-0 where appropriate) so ChatPanel can manage internal scrolling without nested overflow.

Adjust the calendar-embedded chat container sizing to use a mobile-safe height calculation (prefer 100dvh-based sizing) and ensure the wrapper provides a proper height constraint (including min-h-0 where appropriate) so the ChatPanel message list scroll works without causing overflow within the page.
